meta.title: React vs Vue for Enterprise: Framework Comparison
meta.description: Structured comparison of React and Vue.js for enterprise application development across ecosystem, performance, team scalability, and long-term maintainability.

react.notes: JSX requires mental shift; hooks pattern takes time to master; strong TypeScript support

vue.notes: Single File Components intuitive for most devs; Options API gentle entry point; Composition API adds power

react.notes: Largest UI library ecosystem; React Query, Redux Toolkit, React Router, Next.js, Remix, Expo

vue.notes: Strong ecosystem; Pinia, Vue Router, Nuxt, Vueuse; smaller than React but curated

react.notes: First-class TS support; @types/react mature; hooks typed well; industry standard

vue.notes: Vue 3 fully TypeScript rewritten; script setup with defineProps infers well; Volar IDE support

react.notes: Dominant in enterprise; used by Meta, Airbnb, Netflix, Shopify, countless large orgs

vue.notes: Strong in Asia/Europe; used by Alibaba, Nintendo; less common in North American enterprise

react.notes: Most in-demand frontend skill globally; largest hiring pool; highest salaries

vue.notes: Smaller talent pool in most markets; easier to learn so devs ramp quickly

react.notes: Virtual DOM + concurrent features; React 18 Suspense and transitions reduce jank

vue.notes: Vue 3 Proxy-based reactivity more granular; smaller bundle (34 KB vs 42 KB gzipped)

react.notes: Context + useReducer for simple; Redux Toolkit or Zustand for complex; many patterns

vue.notes: Pinia is official, minimal boilerplate; Composition API makes shared state natural

react.notes: Next.js is industry standard; App Router with Server Components; Remix as alternative

vue.notes: Nuxt 3 excellent; file-based routing, auto-imports, Nitro server; slightly smaller community

react.notes: React Testing Library is gold standard; Vitest, Jest, Playwright well-supported

vue.notes: Vue Test Utils + Vitest recommended; solid but smaller body of testing guides

react.notes: Major API shifts (class to hooks); Meta backing ensures longevity; some churn from Next.js

vue.notes: Options API still supported in Vue 3; Composition API is the future; stable governance

react.notes: React Native covers iOS and Android; shared logic with web React; large ecosystem

vue.notes: Vue Native deprecated; NativeScript-Vue maintained but niche; Ionic/Capacitor possible

react.notes: React.lazy + Suspense; granular with dynamic import(); Next.js handles automatically

vue.notes: defineAsyncComponent; Nuxt automatic route-based splitting; on par with React

use_case_recommendations.use_case: Large enterprise SPA with complex state
use_case_recommendations.reason: Largest talent pool, mature state management options, proven at scale
Progressive enhancement model lets you add Vue to existing HTML; faster ramp
React Native shares logic with web React; no equivalent in Vue ecosystem

use_case_recommendations.use_case: Team of mostly backend devs building internal tools
use_case_recommendations.reason: Single File Components and Options API are intuitive without deep JS framework experience
Next.js App Router with Server Components is the most battle-tested SSR solution
Less boilerplate, gentler learning curve, Nuxt batteries-included for quick launches
